impact_assessment.why: Prompt edits were in place and unrecoverable; the Tif report's M2 requires versioned artifacts with rollback.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every skill edit is reversible and attributable; identical content adds no noise.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new routes and a versions directory; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: atomic file replace, last writer wins per version; state: bounded history under the skills storage root.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Versioning is additive, the content file stays the runtime source, and a corrupt index degrades to empty history.

[1/4] Failure consolidation into bounded avoidance knowledge (ADR-047). [2/4] Agent-loop repetition guard with warning then abort (ADR-045). [3/4] Unified daily self-modification budget across improvement, configuration and learning (ADR-046). [4/4] Gates, commit and push.

impact_assessment.why: The remaining P2 control items from the Tif report: repeated failures were never distilled, looping agents only stopped at the iteration cap, and learning writes were unbounded across subsystems.
impact_assessment.benefits: Recurring failures become reviewable advice, loops fail fast with a trace reason, and one operator-visible ceiling bounds self-modification.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: agent loop now returns a fifth value and spend() may stop a run; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: each budget/window uses its own ledger lock; state: additive learning-avoidance and budget ledgers.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Avoidances are advisory, the guard warns once before aborting, and budget reservations are released on failure.

checkpoints.description: Task 'brain-p2-controls' completed successfully.

[1/3] ADR-048 memory evidence links, Bayesian confidence and deterministic contradiction proposals. [2/3] Replace the unbounded per-pair LLM conflict scan, add routes and tests. [3/3] Gates, commit and push.

impact_assessment.why: The last P2 item in the Tif report with a concrete safety payoff: the existing conflict scan made one blocking LLM call per pair with no cap or review.
impact_assessment.benefits: Evidence-based confidence, bounded offline contradiction candidates and reviewable proposals instead of side effects in a GET.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: find_conflicts semantics change from LLM verdicts to deterministic candidates; dependency: none beyond stdlib; concurrency: writes under the memory write lock; state: an additive memory_links table.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Candidates require same subject, opposite polarity and 0.8 overlap; proposals never change confidence until accepted.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] done: memory_links schema with migration, link CRUD, acceptance recomputes confidence transactionally, deterministic contradiction prefilter (same subject, opposite polarity, 0.8 Jaccard) replaces the O(n^2) LLM scan, routes and README updated. impact_assessment.why: The final report item: research fetches had no provenance and no bounded, allowlisted surface.
impact_assessment.benefits: Citable results, offline-testable adapters and no generic web/scraping path.

impact_assessment.mitigation: Failures return 502, stale cache is explicit, and tests mock the network entirely.

checkpoints.description: Task 'research-gateway' completed successfully.

[1/5] Loop guard: drop same-tool stagnation, keep domain ids (ADR-050). [2/5] Guardrails: outputs-only redaction, narrower assignment rule. [3/5] Kernel: worst-component pressure up to 40 points. [4/5] Simulation manifest catalogue and dangling bridges; memory confidence recompute lifecycle; research persist/dedupe/cache cap; skill id validation; budget cap validation; timeout=0 and shared budget charges (ADR-051, ADR-052). [5/5] Tests, gates, commit and push.

impact_assessment.why: The last five pushes introduced controls with false positives and state drift; the review found ten concrete defects.
impact_assessment.benefits: Normal agent work is no longer aborted or rewritten, one failing subsystem can degrade the kernel, evidence confidence stays consistent, and research persistence is idempotent.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: timeout=0 semantics restored, guard behavior narrowed; dependency: none; concurrency: confidence recompute stays inside the write lock; state: links are removed on memory deletion.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Every correction has a failing-first test; no safety default was relaxed, only false-positive paths were removed.
